subject: Staged commit proposal: tranching, eval credit conversion, and close timeline
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Janet Liu <janet.liu@cloudnova.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Staged commit proposal: tranching, eval credit conversion, and close timeline

Janet / Cloudnova team —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a working MAP that ties commercial milestones to evaluation checkpoints so we can align on ramp cadence and pricing as you move from pilot -> production. High-level summary below so your procurement and engineering teams can skim: 

- Evaluation phase (30 days): access to full-hosted API + 50k token/day soft quota for pilot. Redwood provides $15k in evaluation credits (applies to usage only).
- Stage 1 (post-eval, month 1–3): commit to 150k tokens/month (baseline). Unit price discount: 10% off list.
- Stage 2 (months 4–9): commit to 450k tokens/month aggregated; discount steps to 18% once the MAP checkpoint (60% of target usage sustained for 2 weeks) is met.
- Stage 3 (months 10+): long-term committed capacity: 1.2M tokens/month with 25% discount and SLA uplift (SLO 99.9%).

Conditional mechanics we discussed:
- Eval credit conversion: If Cloudnova signs a committed MAP within 30 days of eval completion, up to 60% of eval credits convert to prepayment and reduce month-1 invoice.
- Tranching: discounts escalate at defined MAP checkpoints; failing a checkpoint moves you back to the prior discount tier (no retroactive clawbacks; future billing adjusts).
- Early-sign incentive: we can add a one-time 5% invoice credit if contract is executed by Feb 26 (we'll need managerial approval).

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm procurement timeline and the person who will own the SOW redline (you referenced a procurement lead).
2) Please confirm whether data residency clause (EU-only) is required — this affects our default private deployment addendum.
3) If the structure looks good, I can circulate the SOW draft and DocuSign link for an expedited review.

Attachments: Cloudnova_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP with checkpoint dates and metrics), SOW-draft_Cloudnova_v1.docx (initial SOW)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal approvals once you confirm procurement timeline.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Janet Liu <janet.liu@cloudnova.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudnova.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged commit proposal: tranching, eval credit conversion, and close timeline

Thanks, Olga — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from procurement and engineering after a quick pass: 

- Ramp timing: our pilot cadence is tighter — can we move Stage 1 to a 60-day window instead of 90 to match our roadmap? We need the higher usage band sooner if the pilot performance metrics are met.
- Eval credit conversion: procurement wants the conversion mechanics written into the SOW (not just the MAP). Can you have finance draft language specifying how the $15k credit converts and how it appears on the invoice?
- SOW points: please include a short cancellation clause (30 days) and a security addendum reference. Also: we require an explicit data residency callout (US production only for now).

Procurement lead is Jason Park (procurement@cloudnova.ai). He will take point on redlines.

If you can update the MAP with the tighter Stage 1 timing and SOW language around credit conversion, we can aim for internal review next week. Also include a brief timeline to PO issuance — that will determine whether the early-sign incentive is feasible on our side.

—Janet
Director of Product, Cloudnova
janet.liu@cloudnova.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Janet Liu <janet.liu@cloudnova.ai>, Jason Park <procurement@cloudnova.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged commit proposal: tranching, eval credit conversion, and close timeline

Janet / Jason —

Thanks for the quick feedback. I've updated the MAP to reflect a 60-day Stage 1 window (see Cloudnova_MAP_v3.xlsx) and added explicit language in the SOW draft about eval credit conversion. Key clarifications: 

- Stage 1 (post-eval): 60 days; baseline commit = 200k tokens/month (we bumped this to reduce administrative churn). Discount remains 10% at baseline.
- Credit conversion language (SOW): Up to 60% of evaluation credits convert to prepayment credit if a MAP is executed and all signatures collected within 30 days of evaluation completion. The converted credit will be applied to invoice for month 1 and documented as prepayment on the statement. Redwood finance will provide line-item detail on the invoice.
- Data residency: confirmed — Cloudnova asked for US-only production data residency; we'll append our Private Deployment Addendum and note region-specific infrastructure. (This will trigger an Ops/Private deployment checklist.)

I've attached the updated MAP and SOW draft and created a DocuSign envelope to accelerate redlines: https://www.docusign.com/s/Cloudnova-SOW-v1

Internal note to Ben / Marissa: please confirm whether we can extend the early-sign incentive (5% invoice credit) if Cloudnova signs by Feb 26. Also need a quick legal "+1" on the phrasing for credit conversion so procurement gets a clean clause. If legal wants a different billing mechanic (credit memo vs. prepayment), flag it and I'll coordinate with their rep.

Next step for Cloudnova: Jason, can you confirm PO / expected lead time for issuing the PO once SOW is agreed? If we have a PO by Mar 1 we can lock in the Stage 2 pricing cadence for March billing.

Thanks —
Olga

Attachments: Cloudnova_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW-draft_Cloudnova_v1.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staged commit proposal: tranching, eval credit conversion, and close timeline

Olga / Marissa —

Quick internal: I approve the tranching schedule and the 60% eval-credit conversion language as written, subject to final legal wording (Ben to legal: please prioritize a short billing clause; losing the month-1 credit detail could slow Jason).

I also approve offering a one-time 5% early-sign invoice credit if Cloudnova executes by Feb 26 and issues a PO within 5 business days after signature. This should be contingent on no additional concessions to SLA or scope.

Marissa — please loop in legal and finance now; I don't want procurement to stall on a technicality in the credit wording. Olga — proceed to send the DocuSign envelope to Jason and Janet and mark the deal as "MAP – awaiting PO" in HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567).

Cheers,
Ben
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
